query: SELECT conname FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid IN ('public.kr_approval_items'::regclass, 'public.kr_memories'::regclass) AND conname IN ('kr_approval_items_status_check', 'kr_memories_archive_historical_check', 'kr_memories_current_live_verified_check', 'kr_memories_live_source_check', 'kr_memories_observed_timestamp_check', 'kr_memories_expiry_after_recorded_check') ORDER BY conname ASC LIMIT 20;
